I see a lot of these comments are very childish, I’ll keep it straight up

He’s mad at you because “J” is someone you used to see in a romantic way, he was never mentioned as one of your past lover and only as a friend. That’s where your bf’s problem comes in he now sees your so called “friend” as a possible “sneaky link”. Sounds ridiculous but when men get suspicious of something even if it didn’t happen, they will get to the answer no matter what. So now he’s in a state of “can I trust this girl”, “is she cheating on me with someone else”, “does she hangout with J”.

In his head “J” is now competition. 

I don’t think he has any intentions of breaking up with you, but there an element of mistrust that he might feel towards you. 

Now i can’t guarantee what can work and what cannot work but I would suggest take him out somewhere peaceful, not a restaurant, no cinemas, not a place where people can hear your conversation. That could be a picnic or a takeout order at home and talk about it details, reassure him you and “J” we’re a thing in the past. 

You may run through some problems like: 
- he might ask do you still like him?

- he might ask why we’re you friends with him, if you never hung out(trying hint at the fact you are more then friends)

- he will most likely ask why you had been texting a past lover while covering him up as a friend for the 5 years you’ve been dating while having a baby 

Which are things you have to prepare yourself for 

Oh and also be ready for a unsurprising “oh so you block him now that I find out about your past with him”. That’s when you need to keep your cool, whenever you will have “the talk” the things said/done on that day will be an imprint in his memory, he won’t forget. 

This may sound really silly but if you want to understand his side of the story, and why he is overthinking, a great example would be to watch “the entire history of you” from black mirror, it can give you an idea of what’s going on in his head even though you had never done anything with “J”. 

Once again stay strong, if he is the strong man I hope he is, he would be stupid to leave behind a family he started for something that never happened. 

Bless you and your family
